raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 30 duplicate txn_ids are restated rows: each has a record_version 1 row and a record_version 2 row in raw_transactions (4896 rows, 4866 distinct txn_id). silver_transactions keeps every raw version, so each restated transaction is counted twice downstream. Keeping only the latest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter removes the stale copies and leaves the gold tables unchanged in structure.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
